name: commit
description: Delegate git commit, push, and pull-request workflows to a subagent on the host's cheapest model, keeping routine version-control work off the main session model.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate commit, push, and PR flows to a cheap subagent.
interface.longDescription: Commit mirrors the command surface of the official commit-commands plugin with three skills — commit, commit-pr, and commit-clean — each of which has the main model delegate the whole flow to a subagent running on the host's cheapest available model. The subagent stages related changes, checks for staged secrets, writes a message in the repository's existing style following the host's standard commit conventions, pushes and opens a PR only when the invoked flow asks for it, and commit-clean safely deletes only local branches whose upstream is gone.
defaultPrompt: Commit, push, and open a PR.
Clean up branches whose remote is gone.
